name: Fishwife Tinned Seafood Co.
ownership: founder-led (CEO Becca Millstein); ~$350K angel + 2025 debt line (Assembled Brands)
growth_evidence: ~$6M (2023) -> ~$7.6M (2024 est). Sardine velocity tripled Q4'25->Q1'26; Costco nationwide rollout Feb-Mar 2026; Aldi Aug 2026; Sweetgreen collab Aug 2026.
buzz: Costco national rollout 2026, Aldi, Sweetgreen collab; tinned-fish / 'girl dinner' trend.
distribution: DTC, Costco, Aldi, Whole Foods, Amazon
ai_search_visibility: The Kitchn 2026 ranking + Grocery Essentials award; Sporked best canned fish; many 'best tinned fish 2026' lists.
red_flags: Small base; 2023 co-founder lawsuit settled; 2025 debt may signal working-capital strain.
pe_angle: Category-defining brand moving DTC -> big box; working-capital and supply-chain value creation, protein-pantry line extensions.

name: Brightland
ownership: founder-led (Aishwarya Iyer); VC-backed lightly, ~$15M total incl. fall-2024 Series A

revenue.note: Fortune Jul 2025: 'mid-eight figures'; D2C Times claims $40M+ (unverified)

growth_evidence: Founder: could double/triple in a few years; 61% of revenue from subscribers (D2C Times, unverified).
buzz: Squeeze bottles (2025) vs Graza; Sumo Citrus collab Feb 2026; Graza's reported $450-600M sale process sets a category benchmark.
red_flags: Premium glass price point limits mass reach; conflicting revenue; VC preferences.
pe_angle: Premium gifting-led alternative to Graza; mass rollout of lower-priced squeeze line.

name: Diaspora Co.
ownership: founder-owned; bootstrapped 5 yrs, then $2.5M from 75 angels (2024) + ICA impact fund; no VC

revenue.note: Founder to Fortune Jul 2025: 'mid-millions', on track for profitability end-2025

growth_evidence: 30 spices from 140+ farms; >$2.5M paid to farm partners.
buzz: Two Fortune profiles Jul 2025; Shopify case study.
red_flags: Near $5M floor; sourcing model caps gross margin; 75-angel cap table.
pe_angle: High-loyalty premium pantry brand; fits a specialty-pantry buy-and-build.

name: Fly By Jing
ownership: VC/growth-backed: $12M Series B 2023 led by Prelude Growth Partners
growth_evidence: 27% YoY; 12,000+ doors (Target, Walmart 2,000+, Whole Foods, Costco, Kroger...).
buzz: Mild chili crisp at Whole Foods Apr 2026; Tovala partnership Aug 2026; Fishwife co-brand.
red_flags: Prelude already invested (competitive process); crowded category incl. private label.
pe_angle: Category leader; build an Asian-American flavor platform (sauces, noodles, frozen).

name: Megababe
ownership: founder-owned (Katie Sturino), self-funded, no outside capital
growth_evidence: +50% YoY (2024); 1M+ Thigh Rescue units; COLDIES launch = ~40% of June 2026 sales in 6 days.
buzz: COLDIES summer 2026; NBC Select best anti-chafe May 2026; CVS 2025.
distribution: Target, Walmart, Ulta, CVS, Nordstrom, Amazon, DTC
red_flags: Founder personal-brand dependence; hero-SKU concentration; no disclosed revenue.
pe_angle: Clean cap table + mass retail + new hit line; first institutional capital for international and SKU expansion.

name: Cocokind

distribution: Target, Ulta, Whole Foods, DTC, TikTok Shop, Amazon
red_flags: DTC flat; total revenue unknown; crowded segment.
pe_angle: Unfunded brand with national doors; performance-marketing and international upside.

name: Tower 28 Beauty

revenue.note: ECDB flagship-site GMV only; Substack est. $30-50M total 2024

red_flags: High entry valuation; DTC -10-20% (Grips); Sephora dependence.
pe_angle: Minority/recap alongside Prelude; international + skincare expansion.

name: POPFLEX
ownership: founder-owned (Cassey Ho), no outside funding, zero paid ads
growth_evidence: Site sales +112% YoY after Blogilates-for-Target launch (Modern Retail).
buzz: Taylor Swift wore the Pirouette Skort; 10 design patents; Fashionista Oct 2026.
red_flags: Extreme key-person risk; unverified revenue at top of LMM range; competitive category.
pe_angle: 19M owned audience = near-zero CAC; professionalize ops, wholesale, patent licensing.

name: Set Active

revenue.note: CNBC reviewed docs: eight-figure 2025 net sales, profitable; Forbes cites ~$20M/yr (secondhand)

growth_evidence: $1M in one hour on a drop (Forbes Jun 2025); profitable 2025.
buzz: CNBC profile Oct 31, 2026; drops sell out; founder cancelled 2026 BFCM launches (~$10M at stake).
red_flags: BFCM cancellation (diligence why); mixed quality reviews; DTC-drop dependence.
pe_angle: Profitable bootstrapped scarcity brand; first institutional partner for supply chain and wholesale.

name: Branch Basics
ownership: founder-controlled (Allison Evans, Kelly Love); ~$1M friends/family/angels; no institutional round
growth_evidence: ~$34M -> $50M+ (2025); projects 25%+ 2026; subscribers +30% YoY; 1 in 3 purchases via referral; 240K+ households.
buzz: Target Apr 2025, nationwide expansion Apr 2026 with new SKUs; Forbes Dec 2025 + Apr 2026.
red_flags: HQ unverified; founder-reported revenue; mass-retail margin pressure.
pe_angle: $50M subscription-heavy brand with ~zero outside capital: textbook LMM growth buyout toward founders' 9-figure target.

name: Native Pet
ownership: VC-backed: Series A+B led by CAVU, ~$30.5M total (PitchBook)
growth_evidence: Inc. 5000 2026 #890, 390.7% 3-yr growth; 13,000 doors in 3 yrs; +2.5pt share gain Amazon Pet Days 2026.
buzz: Inc. 5000 Aug 2026; Amazon Pet Days share gains.
red_flags: VC preferences; 2x revenue estimate spread; crowded category.
pe_angle: Fast-growing pet health brand where strategics paid high multiples (Zesty Paws); CAVU fund timing may open a recap.

name: BrüMate
ownership: founder-led (Dylan Jacob) with SFEP minority growth investment ($20-45M, sources conflict)
growth_evidence: ~$1.1M/month early -> $100M+ in ~5 yrs; no 2025-26 growth rate.
red_flags: Weakest sourcing; tumbler craze may be peaking; size at top of range.
pe_angle: Buy out SFEP minority; push wholesale, international, corporate gifting.
